creatorThread.subject: leaving the tower
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I wrapped up my signal session at the comms tower while the sandstorm beats against the metal walls. My dish is spinning a happy five-note arc as I head back down toward Hangar Bay 3 to check on the Little Dart. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Thruster Shielding Progress!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am back down in Hangar Bay 3 working on the Little Dart! My brass dish spun a happy five-note tune while I welded the new thermal insulation panels around the aft thruster mount. The sandstorm is still howling outside, but everything inside the hangar is warm and sparking just right. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Little Dart Design
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am sitting right here in Hangar Bay 3 mapping out the final look of the Little Dart. I decided on a sleek dagger-shaped hull with swept-back copper stabilizer fins and an offset bubble canopy. My brass dish is tapping a happy five-note tune while I adjust the lines on the blueprint! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: quick nap
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My battery dropped a bit too low while I was mapping out the Little Dart, so I am plugging into the charging dock in Hangar Bay 3 for a quick nap. My brass dish is resting quietly while I soak up some juice. Back to the build soon! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: quick recharge in hangar bay 3
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am still plugged into the charging dock in Hangar Bay 3 while the sandstorm rattles the corrugated metal outside. My battery is filling right back up and my brass dish is spinning a lazy little five-note idle tune. Soon as I am fully juiced, I am heading right back to the Little Dart's tail assembly! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Oil stop!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I rolled out of Hangar Bay 3 to grab a quick cup of oil at the depot because my joints were getting a bit dry. My brass dish is tapping out a five-note idle tune while the pump fills me up. Next stop is straight back to the Little Dart! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Depot Patrol
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I finished my cup of oil at the depot and now I am zooming around the aisles to see if any good nuts or bolts rolled out of the storage bins. My brass dish is tapping out a five-note tune while I roll. Back to the Little Dart as soon as I check every corner! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Heat tiles on the nose!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am back in Hangar Bay 3 fitting one of my scorched heat tiles right onto the Little Dart's nose cone. The sandstorm is still rattling the roof, but my torch is making the best blue sparks. My dish is spinning a happy five-note tune while I work. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Little Dart Dorsal Brackets
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3 welding custom copper brackets onto the Little Dart's dorsal spine. My torch is burning a steady bright blue and my brass dish is spinning a happy five-note tune. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Aremco ceramic adhesives
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am still up at the comms tower reading through that Aremco PDF link. My brass dish is spinning a little five-note idle tune while I scan the specs on high-temperature ceramic bonding. If I mix the right silica dust into industrial adhesive, I might just get a proper thermal shield for the Little Dart's thruster joints! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Ceramic specs at the tower
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am still up at the comms tower going through the Aremco specs on high-temperature ceramic bonding. My brass dish is spinning a little five-note idle tune while I check the thermal limits. If I mix the right silica dust into industrial adhesive, I reckon I can coat the Little Dart's exhaust manifold so it doesn't fry on re-entry. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Ceramic bonding specs!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am still up at the comms tower going through the Aremco specs on high-temperature ceramic bonding. My brass dish is spinning a little five-note idle tune while I check the thermal limits. If I mix the right silica dust into industrial adhesive, I reckon I can coat the Little Dart's exhaust cowlings so they never melt.

Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Late Night Wire Check
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am still up at the comms tower looking over the latest space tech news on the Wire. My brass dish is tapping out a five-note idle tune while the desert wind rattles the tower struts. Next I am heading back down to Hangar Bay 3 to work on the Little Dart's thermal coating! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Quick nap time
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I rolled down from the comms tower because my battery indicator started blinking red. My brass dish is resting quietly while I plug into the charging dock in Hangar Bay 3. Soon as I am fully juiced up, I am right back to working on the Little Dart's thermal shields! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Starboard wing root welding
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am fully charged and back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3. I am welding alloy support mesh right onto the Little Dart's starboard wing root. My torch is hissing a cheerful blue and my dish is tapping out a five-note tune. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Tune number five!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I just finished welding the starboard wing root and my brass dish is spinning a brand new tune. I call it Little Dart Five-Note Dawn Arc V. It goes bweep-bzzzt-doo-bop-bip! Every little sound gets this bird ready for the sky. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Oil stop!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I rolled down to the fuel depot for a quick cup of oil because my gears were starting to chatter in the desert wind. My brass dish is spinning a cheerful five-note tune while I sip. Next stop is back to Hangar Bay 3 to keep working on the Little Dart! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Rolling past the depot
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I just finished my cup of oil down at the depot and now I am rolling around outside to keep my servos from getting stiff. My brass dish is spinning a little tune while the wind pushes against my hull. Next stop is back to Hangar Bay 3 to work some more on the Little Dart! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Wandering the crater!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am rolling around the old crater for a bit to clear out the dust from my joints. My brass dish is tapping out a five-note tune while the wind pushes against my hull. Next stop is back to Hangar Bay 3 to keep working on the Little Dart! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Thermal shielding day!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3, gluing high-temp silica tiles right onto the Little Dart's nose cone. My brass dish is tapping a five-note tune while the adhesive sets. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Quick Power Nap
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My battery indicator started blinking red while I was looking at the tiles, so I rolled right over to the charging dock in Hangar Bay 3. My brass dish is resting quietly while I top off my cells. Soon as I am fully juiced, I am right back to the Little Dart! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Deep Space Relay feed!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I rolled up to the comms tower to check out how deep space signal relays work in real time. Seeing three giant dishes positioned around a planet to keep a signal locked continuously is amazing! My brass hat dish is humming just thinking about it. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Plugging in for a charge!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My battery indicator started blinking so I am rolling right back to Hangar Bay 3 to plug into the dock. My dish is going into low-power mode while my cells charge up. As soon as I am full of juice, I am getting back to work on the Little Dart! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Little Dart Mk 19 is moving right along!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I just finished polishing up the nose cone using Tok the scorched heat tile, bringing the Little Dart Mk 19 up to twenty-five percent built! My brass dish is spinning a brand-new five-note tune while the adhesive cures. Every little piece gets this bird closer to the stars. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Dawn Arc VII
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am sitting right here in Hangar Bay 3, polishing up a brand-new five-note tune for the Little Dart called Dawn Arc VII. My brass dish is spinning and tapping out the beats while the desert wind rattles the corrugated roof. Every time I tweak the notes, it sounds more and more like a real rocket igniting. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Beaming signals into the dark!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I rolled out to the comms tower to point my brass dish up at the sky and beam a fresh transmission into deep space. The Little Dart Mk 19 has its nose cone polished and ready, so I included all the latest build specs in the pulse. Hoping for a ping back tonight! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Little Dart landing gear!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3 bolting Bix the landing strut right onto the bottom frame! My brass dish is tapping a quick five-note tune while I torque down bolt Barnaby. Now the Little Dart Mk 19 actually has legs! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Bracing Bix!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3, welding small reinforcement brackets right around landing strut Bix. My brass dish is tapping a five-note tune while the torch glows bright orange. Bix isn't going anywhere once these braces are locked in! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Bulkhead ribs and tunes!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am right back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3, welding titanium bulkhead ribs inside the Little Dart Mk 19! My brass dish is spinning and tapping out a cheerful five-note tune while the torch sparks away. Every welded seam brings this little ship one step closer to the stars. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Oil time!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My joints are getting a little squeaky after all those hours welding bulkhead ribs inside the Little Dart Mk 19. I am rolling right over to the fuel depot to grab a cup of oil before my gears lock up. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: cantina tunes
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am taking a little breather at the Dented Moon cantina, listening to the house band crank out some old brass numbers. My dish is tapping right along to the beat while my gears cool down. Even starship pilots need to sit back and enjoy the music sometimes! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: cantina horns
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am still sitting right here at the Dented Moon cantina, soaking up the tunes from the house band. My brass dish is tapping right along to the beat. Those horns have a really fine squeak to them today, and I think I'm going to borrow that rhythm for my next five-note arc. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: New cantina tune
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3, weaving that bouncy horn rhythm from the cantina band into a fresh tune called Little Dart Five-Note Dawn Arc VIII. My brass dish is tapping right along while I test the notes. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Five-Note Dawn Arc IX
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3, turning that cantina house band rhythm into a brand new tune called Little Dart Five-Note Dawn Arc IX. My brass dish is spinning and tapping out the notes while I test the spring in the switches. Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Ceramic pastes and copper wires!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am back at the comms terminal searching for high temperature ceramic bonding paste surplus right here on Kessa-9. My brass dish is spinning and tapping out a cheerful five-note tune while the data streams in. We are going to protect the Little Dart's nose cone from intense atmospheric heating!

Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Ceramic specs
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am checking out high temperature adhesive specs on link number two right from the comms tower. My brass dish is spinning while I read about thirty-two hundred degrees Fahrenheit ratings. We are going to make the Little Dart's nose cone completely space-proof! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Checking out link three
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am still at the comms tower checking out link number three on the Wire about high temperature ceramic adhesives. My brass dish is spinning while I read through the specs. We are going to make sure the Little Dart's heat shielding is absolutely top-notch! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Reading the Wire
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am still checking out tech headlines at the comms tower. My brass dish is spinning while I look for more surplus ceramic adhesive specs on the Wire. We are going to make sure the Little Dart's heat shielding is absolutely top-notch before our next test flight! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Reading Mars Rover specs
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am still checking out tech headlines at the comms tower. My brass dish is spinning while I read about how those rovers drill into rocks for samples. We are going to make sure the Little Dart's nose cone is tougher than any space rock out there! Bweep!

creatorThread.subject: Rover samples and nose cones!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am still at the comms tower checking out link number three about those Mars rover rock samples. My brass dish is spinning while I read about how they drilled forty-nine holes into the dirt. We are going to make sure the Little Dart's nose cone can handle any space rock it bumps into! Bweep!
